name: SikaRoof VersiDrain 8 Mesh
paste:
SIKAROOF® VERSIDRAIN® 8 MESH: SPECIFICATION CLAUSE SET

Source: SikaRoof® VersiDrain® 8 Mesh, August 2026, Version 01.01 (https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/5/sikaroof-versidrain8mesh.pdf)
Draft for specifier review. Wording, values and standards are quoted from that data sheet; where it is silent the clause says 'Refer to manufacturer.' Confirm the current edition before issue.

1 SCOPE
1.1 Work included. Provide SikaRoof® VersiDrain® 8 Mesh where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (August 2026, Version 01.01).
1.2 Product description. SikaRoof® VersiDrain® 8 Mesh is a transluscent dimpled plastic drain sheet with an intergrated plastic mesh that acts as a base for plaster or shotcrete. The dimpled sheet also acts as a seepage layer for internal dampness control of basement walls. The dimples provide an air gap for reliable ventilation between the outer and inner walls.
1.3 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer - Typical areas of application include.
    - Basement walls
    - Tunnels
    - Underground excavated rock surfaces
1.4 Limits of use. Observe the manufacturer's limitations stated in clause 4.2.

2 MATERIALS
2.1 Product. SikaRoof® VersiDrain® 8 Mesh
    - Supplier as printed on the data sheet: Sika Australia Pty Limited, ABN 12 001 342 329, aus.sika.com, Tel: 1300 22 33 48
2.2 Approvals, certificates and standards stated by the manufacturer. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (August 2026, Version 01.01) has no approvals, certificates or standards section.
2.3 Standards and test methods cited in the data sheet. Cited as written in the data sheet. A citation is not a statement that the product complies with it; conformity is stated only where the data sheet says so (see the approvals clause and the statements quoted in the other clauses).
    - EN ISO 9863-1: cited with a stated property or value. Where: Product Information > Appearance and colour (p.1).
    - DIN 4102: referred to in instructions or limitations. Where: Important Considerations (p.2).
    - BS 8102: referred to in instructions or limitations. Where: Important Considerations (p.2).
    - DIN 18 195: referred to in instructions or limitations. Where: Important Considerations (p.2).
    - DIN 4095: referred to in instructions or limitations. Where: Important Considerations (p.2).
    - DIN 53 576: referred to in instructions or limitations. Where: Important Considerations (p.2).
2.4 Characteristics stated by the manufacturer.
    - Provides an efficient vapour barrier and ventilation system for underground structures
    - Acts as a internal seepage layer for basement walls and tunnels
    - Integrated mesh permits plaster or shotcrete thicknesses of up to 25 mm
    - Wide and easy to handle rolls result in rapid and low cost installation
2.5 Composition, appearance and supply.
    - Appearance and colour: Translucent white HDPE sheet with dimples and grid, total thickness 8 mm. Thickness 8.0 (±0.8) mm (EN ISO 9863-1) Unit weight 600 (±30) g/m²
2.6 Properties stated by the manufacturer.
    - Compressive strength: approx. 150kN/m² (15t/m²)
    - Chemical resistance: Resistant to ground chemicals, rot, moulds, algae, bacteria and root penetration. Does not effect potable water.
    - Drain flow capacity: Drainage Capacity: approx. 5 l/s.m; approx. 300 l/min.m; approx. 18,000 l/h.m
2.7 Packaging, shelf life and storage.
    - Packaging: Roll size 2m x 10m - 20m² per roll
    - Shelf life: 5 years from date of production if stored properly in undamaged, unopened, original sealed packaging
    - Storage conditions: Rolls must be stored in their original packaging and in cool and dry conditions. They must be protected from direct sunlight, rain, snow and ice, etc

3 SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
3.1 Substrate preparation. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (August 2026, Version 01.01) states no substrate preparation requirements.

4 APPLICATION
4.1 General. Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (August 2026, Version 01.01) and the requirements below.
4.2 Limitations and important considerations.
    - Fire resistance: B2 (DIN 4102)
    - SikaRoof® VersiDrain® 8 Mesh is manufactured and tested according to DIN 18 195, DIN 4095, DIN 4102, DIN 53 576 and BS 8102.
4.3 . Dimpled protection sheet back-bonded with grid for plastering support

5 QUALITY CONTROL AND TESTING
5.1 Hold point. Before each application, confirm the site conditions with the manufacturer. HOLD POINT: do not proceed until the Superintendent has released the hold point.
5.2 Conditions to be verified. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (August 2026, Version 01.01) lists no application condition limits.
5.3 Basis of the stated values. All technical data stated in this Product Data Sheet are based on laboratory tests. Actual measured data may vary due to circumstances beyond our control.
5.4 Other tests. For any test method, sampling frequency or acceptance criterion not stated in this clause: refer to manufacturer and the project specification.

6 WARRANTY AND DOCUMENTATION
6.1 Documents to be obtained and submitted. Obtain the current issue of each document before ordering and submit it with the product submission. Documents are listed as published on the manufacturer's website.
    - Product Data Sheet: SikaRoof® VersiDrain® 8 Mesh, August 2026, Version 01.01, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/5/sikaroof-versidrain8mesh.pdf
6.2 Ecology, health and safety. Refer to manufacturer. This is not stated in the data sheet reviewed (August 2026, Version 01.01).
6.3 Warranty. Obtain any product or installation warranty in writing from the manufacturer or its authorised applicator and file it with the project records. Warranty terms: refer to manufacturer.
    - Legal notes: In practice, the differences in materials, substrates and actual site conditions are such that no warranty in respect of merchantability or of fitness for a particular purpose, nor any liability arising out of any legal relationship whatsoever, can be inferred either from this information, or from any written recommendations, or from any other advice offered.
6.4 Application records. Record the product name, batch numbers, dates, areas treated and the conditions measured under clause 5.1, and include the records in the project documentation.
